title: Parts of Speech · Checkpoint
intro: The end-of-unit check. Answer all ten, then submit for grading. Score 80% or higher (8 of 10) to pass and finish Unit 1. You can try again.

questions.prompt: Which word is the NOUN?  “The brave firefighter climbed quickly.”
questions.explain: “firefighter” names a person — that's a noun.

questions.prompt: Which word is the VERB?  “A curious kitten chased the ball.”
Which word is the ADJECTIVE?  “The ancient castle stood silently.”
questions.explain: “ancient” describes the castle — which kind? That's an adjective.

questions.prompt: Which word is the ADVERB?  “She gently closed the door.”
questions.explain: “gently” tells HOW she closed it — that's an adverb.

questions.prompt: Which word is the PRONOUN?  “They found a map under the table.”
questions.explain: “They” stands in for a noun (some people) — that's a pronoun.

questions.prompt: In “The dog barked loudly,” the word “loudly” is an adjective.
questions.explain: “loudly” describes the verb barked (how it barked), so it's an adverb, not an adjective.

questions.prompt: A pronoun takes the place of a noun.
questions.explain: Right — instead of repeating a name, we use she, they, it, and so on.

questions.prompt: Which word is the ADJECTIVE?  “The happy puppy barked loudly.”
Which word is the VERB?  “Three noisy crows suddenly flew away.”
One word, different jobs. In which sentence is “light” an ADJECTIVE?
choices: They light the candles at dusk.
questions.explain: In “a light jacket,” light describes the jacket (how heavy) — an adjective. In the others it's a noun, then a verb.
